terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Zenith. By using our services, you agree to these terms in their entirety.

sections.title: Purpose and acceptance
sections.content: Zenith is a multi-asset financial intelligence platform. These Terms of Service define the rights and obligations between Zenith and any user of the service. Accessing the platform constitutes full and complete acceptance of these terms.

sections.title: Service description
sections.content: Zenith provides real-time market data (crypto, forex, commodities, indices), analysis tools, an economic calendar, alerts, and a watchlist system. The service is provided as-is, without guarantee of continuous availability or absolute accuracy of data.

sections.title: User obligations
sections.content: You agree to use Zenith for lawful purposes only, not to attempt to disrupt the service, not to mass-extract data through automated means, and to respect the intellectual property rights of Zenith and its partners.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.content: All content on Zenith (text, graphics, code, design) is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. Any unauthorised reproduction is prohibited.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.content: Zenith shall not be held liable for financial losses resulting from investment decisions made based on information provided by the platform. Market data is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Zenith is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.content: We collect: (1) account data (email, name) provided during sign-up via Clerk; (2) browsing data (cookies, IP); (3) your preferences (watchlist, alerts, language, currency); (4) anonymised usage data to improve the service.

sections.title: Legal basis and purposes
sections.content: The processing of your data is based on the performance of the service contract (account data, preferences) and on our legitimate interest in improving the service (anonymised analytics). We never sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: Retention period
sections.content: Your account data is kept as long as your account is active, then deleted within 30 days of account deletion. Analytics data is kept for a maximum of 13 months.

sections.title: Your rights (UK GDPR)
sections.content: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, port, and object to the processing of your data. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@zenith.xyz.

sections.title: DPO contact
sections.content: Our Data Protection Officer can be reached at dpo@zenith.xyz. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This page explains how Zenith uses cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: What is a cookie
sections.content: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device when you visit a website. It allows the site to remember your actions and preferences over a given period.

sections.title: Essential cookies
sections.content: These cookies are necessary for the service to function: Clerk authentication session, language preferences, alerts cart. They cannot be disabled.

sections.title: Analytics cookies
sections.content: Zenith uses anonymised analytics tools (PostHog optional) to understand how users interact with the platform. This data is aggregated and does not allow you to be identified.

sections.title: Marketing cookies
sections.content: Zenith does not use marketing or advertising cookies. No third-party cookies are placed for retargeting or targeted advertising.

sections.title: Managing your preferences
sections.content: You can manage your cookie preferences from your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may limit some platform features.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: Zenith is committed to making its platform accessible to everyone, in accordance with international standards.

sections.title: Our commitment
sections.content: Zenith aims to provide a service usable by everyone, including people with disabilities. We follow WCAG 2.1 Level AA recommendations.

sections.title: WCAG 2.1 AA standards
sections.content: Our interface respects accessibility principles: sufficient colour contrast, keyboard navigation, alternative text on images, semantic HTML structure, ARIA labels on interactive elements.

sections.title: Accessibility features
sections.content: Full keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Escape), ⌘K shortcuts (command palette), native dark mode, screen reader support (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver), text resizable up to 200% without loss of readability.

sections.title: Known limitations
sections.content: Some price charts (sparklines, heatmaps) may be difficult to interpret for screen reader users. A textual version of the data is available via the command palette.

sections.title: Contact to report an issue
sections.content: If you encounter an accessibility issue, contact accessibilite@zenith.xyz. We commit to responding within 5 working days and fixing issues within 30 days.
